name: search_knowledge
title: Search FIRMS documentation
description:
Search FIRMS's own documentation — the complete FIRMS FAQ plus the Fire Map disclaimer, the MODIS/VIIRS attribute definitions, and the FIRMS API pages — and return the best-matching entries in full.

Every entry's `body` is FIRMS's text, verbatim, with its `source_url` and `retrieved` date. Quote or closely follow these bodies when you explain what detections mean, their caveats, latency, sensors, or how to use FIRMS; do not answer such questions from memory when an entry covers them. The `snippet` only shows where the query matched.

Ranking is deterministic (BM25 over titles, tags, and bodies). Use plain words or FIRMS terms. Keep `limit` small (default 3): each entry is returned in full. Use `section` (an ID from list_knowledge_topics, such as `caveats`, `viirs`, `modis`, `landsat`, `fire-map`) to narrow a search, and get_knowledge_entry to follow `related` IDs.

This tool does not need a FIRMS MAP_KEY.

meaning.description: What a detection means on the ground

params.query: what does a fire detection mean on the ground

caveats.description: False detections, within the caveats section
